validity.recommendation: Keep the row; consider whether PipelineType should be 'distribution' rather than 'transmission' (both cited sources call these city-cluster 'lateral pipelines'). Optionally fill EndLocation=Riyadh. Not a duplicate, not a phantom.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real. The sheet's own cited source (MEED, ref [4]) plus an independent project-research compilation (BlackRidge Research) both explicitly name the 'Riyadh cluster' of the MGS-3 project at 470 km with 16/12/10/4-inch lateral pipelines. MEED: 'The Riyadh cluster involves laying 16-inch, 12-inch, 10-inch and 4-inch lateral pipelines, covering 470km.' BlackRidge (does NOT cite GEM; attributes map to Energy Intelligence): 'Lay various diameter lateral pipelines (16-inch, 12-inch, 10-inch, 4-inch) in the Riyadh cluster (470km).' Not a GEM-only entity. SPEC: LengthKnown=470 km and Diameter=12,16,10,4 in both match the two independent sources exactly (high). Capacity blank in GEM and in sources (only whole-network 3.15/3.2 bscfd is published) - correctly left blank. StartYear1=2028 matches MEED/BlackRidge completion Q4 2028 (high). DUPLICATE: checked against all 22 roster rows; 470 km / this diameter combo is unique to P6733; the 56-in EWPS trunk lines (P6717-P6731) are physically distinct, and the other small-diameter city clusters (P6732 Eastern-Qassim 116 km, P6735 Yanbu-Rabigh->Makkah 192 km, P6737 Jizan 196 km) are separate named clusters. No duplicate. ATTRIBUTION: Owner/Operator Aramco confirmed by both sources (100% Aramco, high). CLASSIFICATION CAVEAT: this row is one GEM entity aggregating a bundle of small-bore (4-16 in) 'lateral' pipelines feeding the Riyadh demand center off the Master Gas System trunk. Both sources describe them as 'lateral pipelines' in a 'cluster', not a single transmission trunk. PipelineType='transmission' is defensible (they are transport laterals of the national Master Gas System carrying processed sales gas, not local low-pressure mains) but 'distribution' is arguable - flagging for a human call, not overriding.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status=construction confirmed and current. MEED (contractor-selection story, ~Mar 2025) reports MGS-3 construction commenced Q2 2024 with completion scheduled Q4 2028; the Riyadh cluster is one of the 15 pipeline EPC packages. BlackRidge (as of Jan 2025) states on-site activities have commenced and the project remains under construction. As of 2026-07 the completion date (Q4 2028) is still future, so 'construction' is correct - not yet operating, not stale (well within dormancy thresholds; active work is documented). No evidence of a status change newer than the sheet's 2025-08 LastUpdated. StartYear1=2028 aligns with Q4 2028 completion.

summary: P6733 (MGS-3 'Riyadh cluster', 470 km of 16/12/10/4-in laterals) confirmed real, Aramco-owned, construction status current (Q2 2024 start, Q4 2028 completion); length/diameter/status corroborated by MEED + BlackRidge (independent). Only caveat: sources call these 'lateral pipelines' - PipelineType=transmission may warrant a distribution review.
